rows.title: About Occassions Florist
rows.content: Welcome to Occassions, Kozhikode's premier boutique floral design studio. We specialize in handcrafted fresh floral bouquets, elegant gift baskets, gourmet cakes, and bespoke event decorations. Every bouquet is crafted with care, passion, and botanical precision to celebrate your most cherished moments.

rows.title: Frequently Asked Questions
rows.content:
Q: Do you offer same-day delivery? Yes, orders placed before 5:00 PM are eligible for same-day refrigerated express delivery across Kozhikode.

Q: Can I customize my bouquet stems? Absolutely! Use our Flower Customizer to select custom stems, wrapping, and ribbon colors.

rows.title: Privacy Policy
rows.content: At Occassions, your privacy is our top priority. We only collect the necessary information required to process and deliver your orders securely.

rows.title: Terms and Conditions
rows.content: All orders placed on Occassions are subject to product availability and delivery schedule confirmation. Cancellations are permitted up to 4 hours prior to scheduled delivery.

rows.title: Refund Policy
rows.content: If you receive damaged or unsatisfactory flowers, contact us within 2 hours of delivery with photographic evidence for an immediate replacement or full refund.
